reasons.meaning: The call panicked or threw where it had to return.
The call returned no error for a context that was cancelled before the call.
The call failed and returned a value other than the zero value.
The call returned a false presence flag and a value other than the zero value.
The call returned a value other than nil for an input that nothing stored.
The call returned a value other than the zero value for an input that nothing stored.
Two calls with the same inputs returned different values.
The second of two calls panicked or threw.
The call returned an error that does not match the declared sentinel.
The second of two identical calls failed.
The read did not return the value of the write before it.
Two reads of one snapshot returned different values across a write.
One drain returned an element twice.
Two drains returned the same elements in different orders.
A drain did not return exactly the elements that were written before it.
A drain did not return an element that was written before it.
A result or a version was below one that came before it.
A write after a read had a version that was not above the version that the read returned.
The call returned the value that its directive declares unsafe.
The call failed or panicked for the input at the edge of its declared domain.
The call accepted a value that its declared validator refuses.
A call after the close or the settlement succeeded where the declared sentinel was due.
The call succeeded before its declared predecessor ran.
The call failed after its declared predecessor ran.
The observation did not change after the subject settled.
The call had not returned when the clock passed its declared budget.
A count included an occurrence outside its declared window, or left out one inside it.
A task ran before its instant, or had not run once its instant passed.
The result did not change however far the clock moved.
Two calls returned different values while the clock did not move.
A read returned an entry after the clock passed its lifetime.
A read returned a value for a key after its delete.
The named observation did not change after the call.
The call succeeded after the induced failure.
The verify returned no error after the tamper.
The last of the declared attempts failed.
The call did not run the hook that the registrar installed.
A second call did not change the named observation again.
A read in one partition returned the value of another partition.
The replay returned the entries in an order other than the order of their stamps.
The replay did not grow by the entry that the append admitted.
An append returned a position that was not above the position of the append before it.
The inverse did not return the value that went into the forward call.
The second write succeeded where the guard of the contract was due to refuse it.
The call accepted a value that its predicate rejects.
The call succeeded after its declared burst was spent.
The leadership read reported leadership after the resign.
A read found what a failed scope wrote.
The cache returned a value other than the value of its backing.
The put refused the value that the get lent.
The read returned the same page for two cursors.
The compensation refused the step that the call applied.
The reader found a part of a write that failed.
The call returned no error while a call of its dependency failed.
The callable called its failing operation on every call.
Two calls with one key went to two instances.
A call acquired more resources than it released.
The read after a second write did not return the value of the second write.
The list of the variants lacked a variant, repeated one, or broke the order of the declaration.
Two variants rendered one text, or a value outside the variants rendered the text of a variant.
A variant was not valid, or a value outside the variants was valid.
The text of a variant did not parse back to the variant, or the text of no variant parsed without the error of the parse function.
A variant encoded a text other than its own.
The text of a variant did not decode to the variant, or the text of no variant decoded.
An error had no message, a message without the opening, or the message of another error.
One error matched another error under the identity of the language.
The hook Is of an error type disagreed with the identity of the language.
The error type did not return the cause that the check gave it.
The two orders of two inputs returned two values.
The two groupings of three inputs returned two values.
A batch read returned no stored value for a key.
The accessor of a fresh receiver reported an error.
The callable refused a position below the size, or admitted the position equal to the size.
The callable returned something other than its sibling for one input.
The verify reported a change of a chain that appends alone produced.
An acquire after a release reported the taken error.
The stats after a loan were the stats before it.
A call returned on the subject something other than what it returned on the reference.
The use that the reader of the resource read was below the lower bound or above the upper bound.
Two merges in opposite orders read two states.
A call moved the state to a state that the graph does not list as a successor.
A call of the callable changed the total that the reader of the quantity reads.
The rest of an iteration missed a value that a mutation wrote, or yielded a value that a delete removed.
An appended message did not arrive on the channel of a subscription.
A published event arrived another number of times than the delivery mode allows.
A redelivered event did not arrive once more.
A subscription missed an update, returned updates out of order, or returned an update after its stop.
A machine returned a second reply to an inbound call.
A machine took the stop event and did not reply to an inbound call that it had not replied to.
A machine returned an effect other than a reply on or after the stop event.
A machine returned an effect after the step in which its error method returned an error.
An effect that starts a call or a wait had the token of an earlier effect of its machine in the same epoch.
The history of the concurrent calls had no order that keeps their real-time order and in which the reference returns the same results.
A read that ran beside other reads returned another output than it returns with the same arguments when it runs alone.
Calls with one key that ran at once computed their result more than once.
A read after a crash did not return a write that returned success before the crash.
A read after a crash during a write returned a value that no write wrote whole.
A read of a corrupted record returned another value than the write, or an error other than the declared one.
A write that the full medium could not hold returned success, or changed the state.
The call failed and returned a value other than the value of the field of its request before the call.
The transactions of a history had an anomaly that serializability excludes, so the committed transactions had no serial order.
The transactions of a history had an anomaly that snapshot isolation excludes, such as a dirty read or a lost update.
